exercises.question: Which sentence describes a hypothetical change?
options: Reformaría la cocina si tuviera más dinero. [I would renovate the kitchen if I had more money.]
Reformo la cocina cada año. [I renovate the kitchen every year.]
Reformaré la cocina el próximo año. [I will renovate the kitchen next year.]

exercises.sentence: Si tuviera más dinero, __ la cocina.
exercises.english: If I had more money, I would renovate the kitchen.
If I could choose, I would live in a house with a garden.

sentences: Si tuviera más dinero, reformaría la cocina. [If I had more money, I would renovate the kitchen.]
Después ampliaría el salón. [Then I would enlarge the living room.]
Así tendría más espacio. [That way I would have more space.]

exercises.question: Which verb form belongs after «si pudiera elegir»?
options: viviría [I would live]
viviré [I will live]
vivo [I live]

exercises.sentence: También __ las ventanas porque habría más luz.
exercises.english: I would also change the windows because there would be more light.
I would enlarge the living room to have more space.

exercises.sentence: Reformaría la cocina si tuviera más dinero.
options: I would renovate the kitchen if I had more money.
I renovated the kitchen because I had more money.
I will renovate the kitchen if I have more money.

exercises.sentence: Si pudiera elegir, viviría en una casa con jardín.
options: If I could choose, I would live in a house with a garden.
If I can choose, I will live in a house with a garden.
I chose to live in a house with a garden.

exercises.sentence: Cambiaría las ventanas porque así habría más luz.
exercises.english: I would change the windows because that way there would be more light.

exercises.sentence: Ampliaría el salón para tener más espacio.
options: I would enlarge the living room to have more space.
I enlarged the living room to have more space.
I will enlarge the living room tomorrow.
Ampliaría el salón si pudiera. [I would enlarge the living room if I could.]
Ampliaría el salón si puedo. [I would enlarge the living room if I could.]
Ampliaría el salón si podría. [I would enlarge the living room if I could.]
Viviría en una casa con jardín, aunque estaría lejos del centro. [I would live in a house with a garden, although it would be far from the centre.]
Viva en una casa con jardín, aunque esté lejos del centro. [I would live in a house with a garden, although it would be far from the centre.]
Vivía en una casa con jardín, aunque estaba lejos del centro. [I would live in a house with a garden, although it would be far from the centre.]
Cambiaría las ventanas y reformaría el baño porque así sería más acogedor. [I would change the windows and renovate the bathroom because that way it would be cosier.]
Cambiaré las ventanas y reformaré el baño porque así será más acogedor. [I would change the windows and renovate the bathroom because that way it would be cosier.]
Cambiaba las ventanas y reformaba el baño porque así sería más acogedor. [I would change the windows and renovate the bathroom because that way it would be cosier.]

template.prompt: Say that you would renovate the bathroom because that way it would be cosier.
template.answer: Reformaría el baño porque así sería más acogedor.

template.prompt: Say that if you could choose, you would live in a quiet neighbourhood near the centre because it would be more suitable.
template.answer: Si pudiera elegir, viviría en un barrio tranquilo cerca del centro porque sería más adecuado.
